input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11.3 gives us useful run-off rights (continued Customer access under Section 2, surviving support and maintenance, plus the Section 12 source code escrow), but the Agreement contains no post-termination transition-assistance right and no data return/export obligation. The only exit mechanic is a mutual "return or destroy" of Confidential Information at the disclosing party's option, with no format, no timescale and no deletion certification, which does not reach even the fallback (90 days of transition assistance; data export within 30 days). Because Commerce One hosts the MarketSite.net Service through which our Customers transact, our and our Customers' data can sit on its systems with no contractual route back to us. We therefore insert a new Section 11.4 at the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days of request, and deletion with written certification thereafter, carved back for Commerce One's surviving obligations and legal retention so the new clause does not cut across the Section 11.3 run-off.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, and in addition to its surviving obligations under Section 11.3, Commerce One shall: (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers for a period of up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's written request, return to Corio all data of Corio and its Customers then in Commerce One's possession or control, including all data generated through or stored in the MarketSite.net Service, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing, except to the extent retention is required to perform Commerce One's surviving obligations under this Agreement or by applicable law.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short exit provision requiring transition assistance for up to six months at Commerce One's then-current rates and return of our and our Customers' data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, with deletion and certification thereafter. Our playbook requires a data-return and transition right on exit; we can work with 90 days of assistance if six months is an issue.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 11.4 requiring post-termination transition assistance (up to 6 months at then-current rates) and return of Corio/Customer data within 30 days in machine-readable format, followed by deletion and written certification.
